notes.title: Year VII owner
notes.text: The Unction is listed under Jared Sands in the Year VII report. The 2026 workbook draft order labels the former Logan slot “Logan (Sands).” Exact handover date is not recorded.
notes.source: YK Dynasty Preseason Power Rankings - Year 7.docx; YK Dynasty Basketball.xlsx, 2026 (Last Season)!A25

notes.title: 2026–27 games limit
notes.text: Year VII reports 35–55 games per regular-season week, with the maximum prorated for double weeks. This supersedes the archived February constitution’s 50-game maximum. Current Fantrax enforcement is not independently verified.
notes.source: YK Dynasty Preseason Power Rankings - Year 7.docx, opening league updates

notes.title: Archived roster rules
notes.text: The February constitution records 20 main roster spots, 2 G-League spots and 4 IR slots. G-League eligibility is 164 or fewer career games at season start and under 25 FPPG. A five-primary-center cap excludes IR and G-League. These are archived rules, not a fresh eligibility audit.
notes.source: [ARCHIVED] YK Dynasty BBall Constitution (Feb 21 2026 export).docx, Rosters / G-League / Center Restriction

notes.title: 2025–26 champion
notes.text: Year VII reports Nick Jowkar as champion and a 15–0 regular season. The dashboard’s saved standings remain a partial capture and are not overwritten by this report.
notes.source: YK Dynasty Preseason Power Rankings - Year 7.docx, opening paragraph

notes.title: Redistribution remains unresolved
notes.text: The 2026 redistribution sheet contains proposals, available-player lists and empty team selection columns. It does not establish completed selections. Adjacent picks in the future-picks sheets are retained as recorded.

notes.title: Draft chronology
notes.text: A summer draft belongs to the season beginning that fall. The analysis workbook labels the 2021–2025 drafts by the preceding season; this view uses the primary workbook’s dated recap headings. Multi-owner annotations remain unresolved, and compensatory rounds are not fully reconciled.
notes.source: YK Dynasty Basketball.xlsx, 2021–2026 recap headings; yk_trade_analysis.xlsx, Draft Results
